commands.name: set_mode
commands.description: Select active pipelines. Param: both | faces | occupancy | off

commands.name: enroll
commands.description: Enrol the face in front of camera 1 under the given name (look at the camera for ~3 s). Param: name

commands.name: forget
commands.description: Remove an enrolled identity (or 'all'). Param: name

commands.name: list_faces
commands.description: Ack with the list of enrolled identities

commands.name: set_zone
commands.description: Set the occupancy zone. Param: x1,y1,x2,y2 normalised 0..1 (default 0.3,0.05,0.7,0.95)

commands.name: set_mirror
commands.description: Mirror the camera feeds horizontally. Param: on | off (default on)

commands.name: swap_cameras
commands.description: Swap which USB camera feeds the face vs occupancy pipeline

commands.name: file-download
commands.description: Download and apply an update package (.tar.gz with install.sh) from a URL

properties.description: Renesas RZ/G3E EVK Vision Demo (face identity + occupancy)
